correct.description: Dead hang with arms fully extended at the bottom, chin clears the bar at the top with minimal body swing

common_errors.description: Chin does not clear the bar -- insufficient pull height
Excess hip/leg swing used to generate momentum instead of a controlled pull

thresholds._status: SEED values only -- placeholders pending real field-measured tuning per EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md §4. Not authoritative; do not treat as validated.

rep_counting._note: "top" = dead hang (rest reference, highest elbow angle), "bottom" = chin-over-bar (peak flexion) -- same top=rest/bottom=effort convention as squat.json/pushup.json, so this exercise's primary-angle signal direction matches the existing FSM's assumptions if it's ever wired into Stage 5b.

coaching_cues.setup: Hang with arms fully extended, core braced
coaching_cues.execution: Pull your chin above the bar, control the descent
coaching_cues.set_complete_with_flags: Solid work. Next set, watch your {flag_body_part} — {flag_cue}.

flag_cues.partial_rom: Pull a little higher, chin over bar
flag_cues.kipping_swing: Slow down, minimize the leg swing

shoulder_injury.modification: Reduce range of motion or use a resistance band for assistance. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

elbow_injury.modification: Reduce reps and volume. Stop if you feel elbow pain.

hypertension.modification: Avoid breath-holding. Breathe out as you pull up.

model_assist.notes: Advisory only. May detect rule-less errors (e.g. asymmetric pull, excessive shoulder shrug). Cannot override rep count or safety flags. Default off until eval passes.

camera_guidance.framing_note: Phone ~2.5m back, side profile, far enough that the bar and full hang-to-chin travel stay in frame.
